# Google Material Symbols Rounded

The primary automotive icon language uses the official Material Symbols Rounded Android vectors
from Google's `material-design-icons` repository.

- Style: Material Symbols Rounded, 24 px, default weight 400, grade 0, fill 0
- Pinned upstream commit: `50f0603134ce7b70b2d71b686cc13e8b57ccb74c`
- Upstream commit date: 2026-07-31
- Upstream: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
- Browser: https://fonts.google.com/icons
- Copyright: Google LLC and the individual icon contributors
- License: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt` in this directory

Each glyph comes from the official
`symbols/android/<glyph>/materialsymbolsrounded/<glyph>_24px.xml` resource at the pinned commit.
Its 960 by 960 viewport and `pathData` were retained one-for-one. The fill was normalized to white
so the application can apply its existing tint, while the application's stable icon resource names
and persisted catalog keys were retained.
